<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Internship"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfferAcceptance" name="Offer acceptance"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Intern" name="Intern" processRef="Process_Intern"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance"
                      name="Offer acceptance"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_CompanyAccepted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Intern" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Intern" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndAmount" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails" name="Enter experience and hobbies?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeOptionalDetails" name="Continue"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Accept offer" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneWeekPasses" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_OneWeek"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteWeeklyUpdate" name="Write weekly internship status update"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckUpdatesAndCompletion" name="Internship ongoing or fewer than 3 updates?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRecommendationTweet" name="Send recommendation tweet to a friend">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics id="MI_SendTweets" isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Intern" name="Recommendation tweets sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Intern" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndAmount" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_3" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">experienceAndHobbiesProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_4" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_5" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_6" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeOptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_8" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_9" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_10" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_11" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_12" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Event_OneWeekPasses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_13" sourceRef="Event_OneWeekPasses" targetRef="Task_WriteWeeklyUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_14" sourceRef="Task_WriteWeeklyUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_CheckUpdatesAndCompletion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_15" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckUpdatesAndCompletion" targetRef="Event_OneWeekPasses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipOngoing or statusUpdateCount < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_16" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckUpdatesAndCompletion" targetRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweet">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not internshipOngoing and statusUpdateCount >= 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_17" sourceRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweet" targetRef="EndEvent_Intern"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company status updates" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CompanyAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyAccepted" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" name="Write status updates about the intern">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics id="MI_CompanyUpdates" isSequential="true">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">3</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Company" name="Three status updates written"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CompanyAccepted" targetRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" targetRef="EndEvent_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails"

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AcceptOffer"
                   name="Accept offer"
                   messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_OtherOffersInvalid">
      <bpmn:text>As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_OtherOffersInvalid"
                      sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer"
                      targetRef="Annotation_OtherOffersInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WeeklyTimer" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneWeek">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteInternUpdate" name="Write a weekly internship status update (at least 3)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckInternshipAndUpdates"
                           name="Internship finished and at least 3 updates written?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRecommendationTweets"
                   name="Send a separate company recommendation tweet to each friend via Twitter">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics id="MI_RecommendationTweets" isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Intern" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intern_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndAmount" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterOptionalDetails"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"
                       targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">experienceAndHobbiesProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipOptionalDetails"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"
                       targetRef="Gateway_MergeOptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalDetailsToMerge"
                       sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies"
                       targetRef="Gateway_MergeOptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToReceiveOffer"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_MergeOptionalDetails"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToDecision"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"
                       targetRef="Gateway_DecideOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptOffer"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_DecideOffer"
                       targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyOffer"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_DecideOffer"
                       targetRef="Task_DenyOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerDenied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeniedOfferToNext"
                       sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptedToTimer"
                       sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer"
                       targetRef="Event_WeeklyTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToInternUpdate"
                       sourceRef="Event_WeeklyTimer"
                       targetRef="Task_WriteInternUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateToCheck"
                       sourceRef="Task_WriteInternUpdate"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CheckInternshipAndUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueWeeklyUpdates"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CheckInternshipAndUpdates"
                       targetRef="Event_WeeklyTimer">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRecommendations"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CheckInternshipAndUpdates"
                       targetRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweets">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipFinished and statusUpdateCount >= 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendationsToEnd"
                       sourceRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweets"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Intern"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company status updates" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CompanyAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyAccepted"
                                   messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about the intern">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics id="MI_CompanyUpdates" isSequential="true">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">3</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_CompanyAccepted"
                       targetRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2"
                       sourceRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateToCheck"
                       sourceRef="Task_WriteInternUpdate"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CheckUpdatesAndFinish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueWeeklyUpdates"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CheckUpdatesAndFinish"
                       targetRef="Event_WeeklyTimer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipOngoing or statusUpdateCount < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRecommendations"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CheckUpdatesAndFinish"
                       targetRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweets">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipFinished and statusUpdateCount >= 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendationsToEnd"
                       sourceRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweets"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Intern"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company status updates" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CompanyAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyAccepted"
                                   messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Company" name="Three status updates written"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_CompanyAccepted"
                       targetRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2"
                       sourceRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
